name: cn.dianyinhuoban.hm.mvp.machine.view.MachineTransferActivity
description: The Dianyin Guanjia Hongmeng Edition (电银管家泓盟版) SDK from holderman has a screen that lists machines available for transfer, shows their activation state, and provides actions to start a transfer or view transfer records.
disableEffect: Users will lose the machine transfer list and its transfer actions.
